F/J short bowls and LED pill. Unchanged and right against omaat_room24 and tt_window. Pill 0.088 of the pane width (photo 0.094).
PY/Y full-height tubs and raised bezel. Unchanged: tub aspect ~0.40 against ~0.42 and pane centre 0.54 against 0.54 (sp_py14). A faint light card remains on the tub floor. The lip band is lighting's.
Pane tunnel lining and seal. Unchanged and right.

Electric shades. The ramp stripe helped: the close-up now reads as soft folded pleats, not ruled grooves. Tone and hue are held (0.61 of the wall, B-R -13). The contrast is still about half the photo's (cv 0.17 against 0.32), and the dark face is a 1 px trough, where room24 has a wide dark plateau and a bright edge line. Far shades are clean apart from the old faint residue. The sheer is unchanged and right.

Manual PY/Y shades. Unchanged in the shell (s08 diff 0.18, sky only). The half and stowed states read right against sp_py24. Not re-checkable in the studio because w14/studio/win_front is a harness misframe: it shows the cabin interior near a curtain, not the window-unit studio (mean diff 287).

Dado, grilles and placards. The louvres now read: lit slats over a dark plenum, ~22 per grille, cv 0.14 (photo 0.45), with the ribs subdued in the studio. The grille field is 0.76 of the dado (photo ~0.66). In b_dadoY2 the field under the seat is near black (20) with fine light lines, which is a little harsh, but that is mostly shadow [lighting].
Floors. Unchanged: Y navy right; vinyl hue right (B-R -2) but fine speckle half the photo's (L std 12.5 against ~24).

Type A door surround and viewing window. Larger and better proportioned: the reveal is 1.11x the arm-arc box height (photo 1.36x), and the width is right. The top still sits level with the box top, where the photo's bezel rises ~0.2 box heights above it. The new shade panel is present but faint (0.95 of the glass), and its finger slot is invisible because it is buried behind the shade face (see issues).

issues.detail: Door viewing-window finger slot is invisible (sign bug)
issues.problem: The dark slot added in 06f9c5a cannot be seen. The shade region in b_doorWin has no pixel darker than 198.
issues.evidence: 07_shell.js: shell.add(gBox(0.05, 0.008, 0.004), M4.mul(tabF, M4.trs(0, -0.05, -0.003)), MAT.darkPlastic). windowFrame's Z is the inward (cabin) normal and the shade box spans z +-0.003, so the slot (z -0.005..-0.001) sits behind the shade's visible face. b_doorWin rows 395-445 / cols 535-585: min 198, mean 226.
issues.fix: Change the slot offset to M4.trs(0, -0.05, +0.0035) so it stands just proud of the shade face, or make it a recessed dark inset at +0.0031.

notes: w14 against w13 (commit 06f9c5a, shell only), same camera set. The shell pixel diffs are confined to the blackout pleats (b_jClose 2.8, s05 1.25, ra_jWin), the door window (b_doorWin, s06, s07) and the grilles (win_low 4.5, b_dadoY2). Other diffs are sky or seats. All three changes helped. The pleats now read as folds rather than ruled lines, with the tone held at 0.61 of the wall. The grille louvres are visible (cv 0.03 -> 0.14) and the ribs are subdued. The door window is larger with the right width and its own shade. Nothing regressed in the shell geometry, but one fix did not land: the door-window finger slot is buried behind the shade face (z sign; min pixel 198), so it does not render. The door window is also still ~20 % short at the top against lalf_133, and the shade separates only faintly from the glass. Harness problem: studio/win_front is misframed. Detail scores: 8.1 / 8.6 / 8.4 / 8.4 / 8.6 / 8.2 / 8.3 / 8.4 / 8.1. No high or medium issues. Overall 8.5, unchanged, because the gains are small and the area is now limited by the low-level items (wall weave, vinyl grain, pleat contrast, door window).
